failure_caught: A writer that accepts a value the loader would reject as a finding, or that leaves a partially rewritten document or a temporary file after refusing a save.
behavior: Eighteen path/value pairs with the wrong type or enum spelling are each refused by set() with 'could not save <path>' naming the expected type, and the dashboard.toml bytes and single-file directory stay untouched.
uniqueness_reason: parse_path_is_the_only_setting_path_grammar covers path grammar, and the loader tests cover wrong-type findings on read; typed-value refusal through the writer is unique to this table (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/settings/write.rs:517).
criticality_reason: dashboard.toml is durable user configuration; a wrongly typed write can replace a whole setting with a loader finding on the next read (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/settings/write.rs:397-465).
recommendation_reason: Only typed-value rejection table through the writer; exact bytes plus file-count assertions.
fidelity_reason: Runs the production set()/save() over a real tempdir document and real filesystem, checking file counts directly.
signal_reason: Each of the 18 cases asserts the refusal prefix, the exact expected-type text, byte-identical document contents and exactly one file left in the directory (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/settings/write.rs:806-864).

failure_caught: A sound-choice edit that rewrites or drops the notification/sound/branch settings, or a reset that leaves the choice set instead of restoring the default.
behavior: All sixteen combinations of notifications and ready_sound with each of the four sound choices save through set(), reload as the chosen choice with the other preferences and branch_prefix intact, report a Document-sourced row with the 'default' default, and removal restores the exact original bytes and the Default choice.
uniqueness_reason: settings loader tests cover how a sound choice is read; this is the writer round trip across all sixteen consent combinations (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/settings/mod.rs:897).
criticality_reason: Only the ready-sound preference is affected; the user can re-edit the file (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/settings/write.rs:867-913).
recommendation_reason: Only writer round-trip matrix for the sound choice with unrelated opt-ins.
fidelity_reason: Real tempdir documents and the production loader/writer for every combination.
signal_reason: Asserts the reloaded choice, all three unrelated settings, an empty finding list, the row source/value/default, and byte-prefix equality before reset plus byte equality after it.

failure_caught: An unrelated edit rewriting or dropping an invalid value (silently changing its meaning to the default), or a save reporting success while the loader would still report a finding.
behavior: Six invalid ready_sound_choice spellings each load as unset with one finding at line 3; saving the identical invalid value is refused, an unrelated branch_prefix edit preserves the raw choice line and the same finding, and a later valid save clears the finding while keeping the edited prefix.
uniqueness_reason: settings tests cover fail-closed reading; preserving an invalid value across an unrelated writer edit is unique to this test (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/settings/mod.rs:897).
criticality_reason: A lost invalid-value finding misstates the effective sound choice but does not affect sessions (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/settings/write.rs:916-955).
cost_drivers: six tempdirs with raw invalid spellings
recommendation_reason: Only preservation/refusal coverage for invalid sound values in the writer.
fidelity_reason: Real files plus the production loader and writer on each of six raw spellings.
signal_reason: Asserts the exact finding key/line, refusal of the identical invalid value, preservation of the raw line and comment, finding equality before and after, and the repaired state.

failure_caught: A typo'd setting path silently creating a new key or a new file, so the caller believes an edit succeeded.

uniqueness_reason: parse_path_is_the_only_setting_path_grammar covers grammar edges; declared-path rejection plus the no-file invariant is asserted only here (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/settings/write.rs:517).
criticality_reason: A silent no-op on a settings path leaves the user's intended setting unchanged (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/settings/write.rs:65-103).
recommendation_reason: Only coverage of unknown declared paths not creating a document.
fidelity_reason: Calls the production declared()/set() with no fixture document at all.
signal_reason: Ten paths each assert the exact 'no setting named' message for set and an error for remove, and the document's non-existence.

fidelity_reason: Real symlinks and permission bits on a real filesystem through the production save().
signal_reason: Asserts read_link identity, target bytes, target mode 0444/0640 and exact file counts for four edit paths across both read-only states, then a successful through-link edit.

recommendation_reason: Only temp-creation failure coverage with a real permission fault.

failure_caught: Cancel returning before the worker is published (the cancellation is lost and the run continues), or deadlocking against the admission lock.

signal_reason: Asserts cancel does not return within 50 ms, then the flag and the final Cancelled status after both hooks release.

failure_caught: Graceful shutdown reporting success while an admitted task run exists, so the server exits with a task still running.

signal_reason: Asserts the shutdown call does not return in 50 ms, then the SessionsRemain code and stopping false, then a clean stop.

failure_caught: Quota settings in the instance identity file being applied (ghost configuration) or the finding disappearing when a dashboard document exists.
behavior: A legacy identity file containing [quota] yields one finding keyed 'quota' at line 3 saying it belongs in dashboard.toml while rows stay at defaults; beside a full document the document's values win and the finding persists.
uniqueness_reason: tests/provider_quota.rs quota_table_in_instance_identity_is_a_finding_and_starts_no_worker proves the same claim end to end including the worker not starting (tests/provider_quota.rs:598).
criticality_reason: The identity-file quota table is inert by design; honoring it would duplicate or override the real consent setting (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/settings/mod.rs:75-95).
cost_drivers: real legacy identity file and document
recommendation_reason: Retained for the loader-level rows/finding coexistence assertions.
fidelity_reason: Real legacy identity file and document paths through the production loader.
signal_reason: Asserts the single finding key/line/message, rows default with no document, and document values plus the same finding when a full document exists.

failure_caught: Not following the symlink, so a dotfiles-managed settings file silently loads defaults.
behavior: A dashboard.toml symlink to a dotfiles document loads the target's full settings with no findings and non-default rows, and the report path is the link.
uniqueness_reason: dangling_symlink_is_a_document_finding_not_a_fresh_install is the broken-link complement (crates/ovrcr-runtime/tests/settings_matrix.rs:823-846).
criticality_reason: A dotfiles user would see no settings applied (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/settings/mod.rs:48-90).
cost_drivers: real symlink to a full document
fidelity_reason: Real symlink and target through the production loader.
signal_reason: Asserts empty findings, row equality with the target document, inequality with defaults and the report path being the link.

failure_caught: A broken symlink treated as a fresh install (defaults with no finding), hiding that the user's settings vanished.
behavior: A dashboard.toml symlink to a missing target reports default rows, unparseable false, and exactly one keyless finding with the exact 'dangling symlink' message and no line.
uniqueness_reason: symlinked_document_is_followed covers the valid link; write.rs covers refusing edits through a dangling link (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/settings/write.rs:1073-1131).
criticality_reason: The user's settings would silently revert to defaults with no diagnostic (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/settings/mod.rs:48-70).
fidelity_reason: Real dangling symlink through the production load_document.
signal_reason: Asserts the exact finding message, key None, line None, unparseable false and default rows.

failure_caught: Refusing to read a read-only settings document, so the user sees defaults and believes their configuration was lost.
behavior: A 0444 dashboard.toml loads its full settings with no findings.
uniqueness_reason: write.rs edits_refuse_dangling_links_and_read_only_targets covers refusing edits to a read-only target; reading it is the complement (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/settings/write.rs:1073-1131).
criticality_reason: Settings display only; a read-only file is a plausible dotfiles/Nix setup (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/settings/mod.rs:48-90).
fidelity_reason: Real 0444 file through the production loader.
signal_reason: Asserts empty findings and row equality with the document's values.

failure_caught: Accepting an out-of-range delegation limit or an unknown harness/model, so delegation runs with unbounded children or routes to a nonexistent backend.
behavior: Seven delegation settings save and reload with the expected limits/model, then seven invalid values (0 and 51 live children, 0 and -1 attempts, unknown harness, unknown model) are refused with bytes unchanged; resetting the attempts limit removes it.
uniqueness_reason: settings::tests::progress_deadline_accepts_only_bounded_positive_milliseconds covers a sibling bound; the delegation set is unique (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/settings/mod.rs:1019).
criticality_reason: max_live_children is the delegation concurrency cap; a 51 value breaks the bounded-delegation policy (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/settings/write.rs:18-63).
cost_drivers: real document with seven valid and seven invalid writes
fidelity_reason: Real document through the production writer and loader.
signal_reason: Asserts seven accepted values, both limit readings, preserved bytes and comments, then seven refusals with byte equality and the reset result.

failure_caught: An unknown cloud model accepted (a remote run with an unsupported model), or the accounts write dropping other settings.
behavior: A cursor_cloud_accounts sample saves and reloads with the exact account name and model while branch_prefix and comments survive; changing the model to 'auto' is refused with bytes unchanged.
uniqueness_reason: settings::tests::cursor_cloud_profiles_are_typed_and_fail_closed covers the loader typing; this covers the shared writer round trip (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/settings/mod.rs:885).
criticality_reason: A wrong cloud model is re-editable and bounded to Cursor cloud launches (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/settings/write.rs:18-63).
cost_drivers: real document with a cloud-account list
fidelity_reason: Real document through the production writer.
signal_reason: Asserts the reloaded account name/model, preserved branch_prefix and comment, and byte equality after the refused save.

failure_caught: A theme the writer accepts but the loader rejects (the dashboard silently falls back), or an unapproved near-miss theme being accepted.
behavior: Each of the eighty ThemeId values saves, reloads to the same theme with no findings while other lines survive, and a '<theme>-not-a-variant' save is refused with bytes unchanged; resetting yields Dark.
uniqueness_reason: TUI theme tests cover rendering and catalog appearance, not settings persist/reload (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/theme.rs:651).
criticality_reason: Theme choice is cosmetic; a bad theme falls back visually (crates/ovrcr-protocol/src/settings.rs:240-260).
recommendation_reason: Only settings round trip over the full theme catalog.
fidelity_reason: Real document through the production loader and writer for every theme.
signal_reason: Asserts the reloaded id, empty findings, preserved lines, the exact theme line, and byte equality after every near-miss refusal, then Dark after reset.

failure_caught: A historical alias rejected (the user loses their theme) or a load rewriting the document (spontaneous config mutation).
behavior: Five historical theme spellings load as their canonical ThemeId with no findings, and the document bytes are unchanged after loading.
uniqueness_reason: No other test covers the alias map through the production loader (crates/ovrcr-runtime/tests/theme_catalog.rs:33-50).
criticality_reason: Theme aliases only; a rejection falls back to the default theme (crates/ovrcr-protocol/src/settings.rs:240-330).
fidelity_reason: Real documents through the production loader.
signal_reason: Asserts the canonical theme, empty findings and byte-identical documents for five aliases.

failure_caught: Accepting a research-only theme family (shipping an unaudited theme) or a failed save clobbering the saved theme.
behavior: With theme 'catppuccin-mocha' saved, the four research-only family names are refused by set() and the document stays byte-identical, so the saved theme survives.
uniqueness_reason: No other test asserts the research-only exclusion through the writer (crates/ovrcr-runtime/tests/theme_catalog.rs:53-64).
criticality_reason: An unapproved theme is a visual/design-lock issue, not a destructive one (crates/ovrcr-protocol/src/settings.rs:240-330).
cost_drivers: four refused names on one document
fidelity_reason: Real document through the production writer.
signal_reason: Asserts an error and exact byte equality of the document for each of four names.
